author: CoreLoader
name: CoreLoader mod
description: A C# mod for a YYC GameMaker game running CoreLoader. Builds straight into the game's Mods folder; with hot reload on, the running game picks it up.

gameDir.description: The game's folder (the one holding the exe, version.dll and Lodestone\).

gameName.description: The game's exe name without extension, e.g. StoneShard. Restricts the mod to that game; leave empty for a mod that runs in any game.

interop.description: The generated interop's namespace (Lodestone\Interop\<interop>.Interop), e.g. StoneShard or Dwarf_Eats_Mountain. Leave empty to write the mod without it.
